releases.notes:
Test build #2. Now includes crafting recipes so you don't need /rspeaker give to obtain units in survival.

**New since test1:**
- Microphone recipe: note block on top, iron ingot below, three redstone along the bottom (1 note block + 1 iron + 3 redstone).
- Speaker recipe: iron housing wrapping a note block, redstone underneath (1 note block + 5 iron + 1 redstone).

**Carried over from test1:**
- Sneak + right-click any placed mic/speaker to open the vanilla sign editor and rename it on the spot.

Heads-up: still a test version. Please report any weirdness via the bug template.

mods.description: Blocks that relay Simple Voice Chat audio across distances via named channels.

releases.notes:
First public cut.

Server-side voice memo PA system on top of Simple Voice Chat. Mics and speakers are vanilla player heads with fixed skin textures, so vanilla clients can join without crashing.

See the [Modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/) for the polished feature list and screenshots.

**Drop the jar in your server's `mods/` folder.** Requires Minecraft 26.1.2, Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.0, Fabric API, and Simple Voice Chat ≥ 2.6.0 on the server.
